Game Overview

In Funny Jack, the core idea is straightforward: join Jack the pumpkin as he leaps across Bunnyville, collecting magical eggs in the thrilling Egg-stravaganza. Navigate shifting elastics and tricky obstacles, unlocking new realms filled with surprises. Stay sharp, make strategic friendships, and become a legendary egg collector in this enchanting adventure.
